method: Root adjudicator reread source text for reader disagreements, considered the independent third reading and retained an evidence-based decision before inspecting initial classification labels. Twenty agreement checks were also retained. All source judgments remain AI judgments.

decisions.rationale: A contractual SLA change does not establish a changed product capability or actual performance.
The managed Quick Start entry adds supported webhook deployment templates to existing ingestion, rather than a new event processing operation.
The GA text alone does not establish a functional delta.
Queue-front ordering snapshots expose a distinct scheduling observation operation, not merely an added response field.
Linking existing resources is an environment creation option, with deployment behavior explicitly unchanged.
The body explicitly adds a default choice alongside the geographical rollout.
Automatic native contact-history capture is explicitly contrasted with prior custom profile construction.
These are open-source sample templates, not a changed managed product operation.
Generation of acknowledgement artifacts and their events is a distinct processing operation.
A deployable caching gateway type is a substantial subsystem, not merely another configuration field.
Earlier official AWS text confirms this is geographic rollout; preserve the additional source evidence.
MERGE and multidimensional aggregation introduce distinct SQL operations; the simultaneous size limit is lower magnitude.
Managed unplanned failover is distinct from planned switchover, including maintaining the cluster configuration.
CloudFormation support exposes existing PCS resource lifecycle operations through established provisioning tooling.
A general SDK invocation interface broadens workflow composition beyond curated service integrations; magnitude is based on the interface, not the number of services.
The source explicitly describes bulk whole-graph variants of existing fetch/insert/delete operations.
